newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC says Q3 volume up 41 pct to $6.9 bln.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC says Q3 volume up 41 pct to $6.9 bln.

text.p: AMBAC Inc's AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Friday it insured $6.9 billion of municipal bonds in the third quarter, a 41 percent rise over the $4.9 billion the company insured in the third quarter of 1995.
For the year to date, AMBAC said it insured $18.4 billion, a 60 percent jump over the $11.5 billion the company insured during the first nine months of 1995.
Final market share figures are not yet available, but AMBAC said it estimated its volume figures represented a 37 percent share for the third quarter and a 29 percent share of the year-to-date total.
